messages:
omar: Need a compact GA readiness brief for next partner sync. Must fit one slide: SLA bullets, monitoring gates, support model, pricing fallback. Who can take which bullet?

tasha: I can own SLA + exclusions. Proposal: Hosted 99.9 monthly, Dedicated 99.95. Exclude customer-controlled network/auth. Add a short line about credit triggers (threshold + credit cap).

indra: Ill do monitoring and rollouts. Call out p95 per-route and p99 tail with alert windows. Add daily synthetic quality check for gen models and a regression rollback policy.

yoel: Support model: PLG = self-serve docs + business-hours email; Dedicated = 24/7 oncall + dedicated TAM for first 90 days. Add canned FAQ about SOC2/KMS/audit logs.

carla: Pricing fallback: draft text 20% burst pool at x2 rate; committed baseline discounts for Dedicated; finance to confirm numbers. Also need an explicit billing cap clause for early customers.

sales-bot: New doc link created by sales-bot: https://internal.redwood/drive/ga-briefing-compact (edit access to owners)

omar: Nice. Indra: include a one-line canary policy (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) with auto-fallback for first two phases.

indra: done. Also adding a short test plan: 48h soak + randomized 30s preemption events; pass if error budget < 5% and cache warm >=80% within 6h.

tasha: SLA runbook stub: pager flow + credit calc trigger (eg: sustained Sev0 > 30m). I'll add exact wording and legal exclusions.

yoel: I'll draft the customer onboarding checklist for Dedicated (network allowlist, cert exchange, KMS handshake, 30m provisioning call) and a short external incident template.

carla: Posting pricing fallback draft in the doc now and will ping finance for numbers.

omar: Timeline: owners, please drop edits in the shared doc by tomorrow 10am PT. I'll assemble the slide after that. If anyone blocks, ping me now.

sales-bot: Reminder scheduled: owners review due in 24h
